description: Deterministic npm package.json and PyPI requirements.txt supply-chain auditor flagging malicious lifecycle scripts, mutable URL or git sources, typosquatting, and hidden Unicode. Returns signed Ed25519 audit receipt. Requires $0.005 (5000 atomic) Base USDC.

inputSchema.description: Package manifest object or string: { manifest, ecosystem?: "npm"|"pypi" } or raw package.json object.

dependencies.description: Optional npm dependencies map when passing raw package.json fields.

ecosystem.description: Target package ecosystem: npm or pypi.

manifest.description: Supplied package.json object or raw requirements.txt text.

scripts.description: Optional npm lifecycle scripts map checked for install hooks.

name: screen_package_risk
